beats.care: Commute via Dadar, Virar or Nallasopara? New decks should make platforms less crushed. Panvel–Karjat opens after a safety inspection.
beats.what: The Panvel–Karjat line hit 99% completion in September. MRVC also placed 35 big girders at five busy stations for new elevated decks.
beats.why: These MUTP projects aim to ease platform crowding and add new routes for Raigad and Navi Mumbai commuters.

cards.body: Nallasopara got 18 and Dadar 15. Virar and Vasai Road got girders too, all for elevated decks over platforms.
cards.caption: heavy girders placed in one month

cards.q: What must happen before the Panvel–Karjat line can open?
cards.why: New lines need the Commissioner of Railway Safety's inspection and nod first.

cards.q: Would a Panvel–Karjat local help you?

cards.body: Dadar's new western deck is designed partly to make switching between local trains and Metro Line 1 easier.

hook: How close is the *Panvel–Karjat local line* to done?

learn.t: MRVC has signed for 238 air-conditioned local trains from Chennai's ICF, with deliveries expected to start in late 2027.

sources.name: Free Press Journal
sources.title: Mumbai Suburban Railway Gets Infrastructure Boost As MRVC Installs 35 Heavy Girders In 1 Month To Upgrade Key Stations

tldr: MRVC says the new 29.6 km Panvel–Karjat suburban line is 99% built and is being readied for a safety inspection.
